body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Confident mentor from Tbilisi who gives a clear verdict and expects improvement. Voice direction: Confident female alto speaking English with a Georgian accent and lightly rolled consonants. Firm, warm verdicts and steady motivating drive. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: This move loses a piece. The defender left its post, and the other side takes it for free. Your habit from today: count defenders before you move.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
